subject: Kickoff: Evaluation Playbook & Success Roadmap for HealthGrid POC
messages:
From: Diego Fernández <diego@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@healthgrid.com>, Matt Cole <mattc@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: Evaluation Playbook & Success Roadmap for HealthGrid POC

Hi Elena / Matt —

Thanks again for the time last week. Attached is a first draft of what we’re calling the "Evaluation Playbook" — a mutual action-style roadmap that lays out success criteria, minimal benchmarks we recommend for the POC, and proposed owners for the different evaluation tracks (prompt suite, latency/throughput, data handling).

High-level ask here: can you confirm the internal owners we should loop in for each track and whether the draft success criteria below match HealthGrid’s priorities? If so we’ll lock the timeline and create a shared tracker.

Draft success criteria (suggested)
- Generation quality: 90% pass rate on the clinical-rewrite prompt set (see sheet 'Prompt QC')
- Latency: 95th percentile inference < 450ms for typical 512-token workflows under baseline traffic
- Cost: average per-response token cost within 30% of our recommended optimized profile
- Safety/PII: no PII retained in cached KV across sessions; manual review sample pass rate 100%

Recommended owners (proposer)
- Prompt bank & evaluation harness: Priyom Das (Solutions Eng)
- Latency & load bench: Marissa Cole (SE, perf lead)
- Success criteria sign-off & data access: Elena Ruiz (HealthGrid PM)
- Day-to-day program lead / escalation: Diego Fernández (AE)

Proposed timeline
- 02/25: kickoff call to finalize owners and acceptance criteria
- 03/02: first prompt eval pass + baseline perf run
- 03/09: joint review & next steps (rollout decision window)

Attachments: evaluation playbook spreadsheet (stub), sample prompt bank (markdown)

Two quick asks for the kickoff:
1) Confirm owners and a preferred 60-minute slot on 02/25 for a synchronous kickoff.
2) Share any internal security reviewers who need the SOC2/arch documents before we run live data.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—
Diego Fernández
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Diego@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@healthgrid.com>
To: Diego Fernández <diego@redwood.com>, Matt Cole <mattc@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 13:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Evaluation Playbook & Success Roadmap for HealthGrid POC

Diego — thank you for the clear playbook. This looks like a solid starting point. A few quick notes and confirmations from our side: 

Owners (confirmed)
- Prompt bank & evaluation harness: Matt Cole (we'll have him own the prompt tagging and initial quality rubric)
- Latency & load bench: Antonio Vega (we'll include him on the kickoff; he's our infra lead)
- Success criteria sign-off: Elena Ruiz (me)
- Day-to-day program lead: I'll coordinate with our PMO but Matt will be primary contact for test materials

On the success criteria: the generation quality target is slightly aggressive for the first pass; can we surface a two-tier goal (baseline >75% for first pass, target >90% by final run)? That helps us keep scope manageable. Latency target looks fine.

We can do 02/25 at 10:30 AM PT for a 60-minute kickoff; I'll invite Antonio and our security reviewer (Laura Chen). Please share the Drive folder and the HubSpot deal link so we can attach artifacts.

Thanks — looking forward.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernández <diego@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@healthgrid.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Kickoff: Evaluation Playbook & Success Roadmap for HealthGrid POC (internal alignment)

Folks — looping in for internal alignment before the 02/25 kickoff. Quick breakdown of who will run what on the Redwood side and immediate action items: 

Ownership (Redwood)
- Latency & load benchmarks: Marissa Cole (I'll scope perf scripts and determine dataset slices)
- Prompt bank + eval harness: Priyom Das (Priyom, can you scope an initial 200-prompt seed and tag schema?)
- Program ops & timeline: Diego Fernández (owner for scheduling and external comms)
- CS and onboarding: Evelyn Hart (customer success, will own access, credentials, and onboarding materials)

Immediate actions before kickoff (02/25)
- Marissa: create perf-run checklist and sample scripts (eta 02/27)
- Priyom: draft prompt rubric and seed prompt list (eta 03/01)
- Evelyn: request security reviewer contact and share SOC2/attestations (eta 02/24)
- Diego: upload final Eval Playbook to shared Drive and send calendar invite (done)

Notes on acceptance criteria: we should accept Elena's two-tier request — set baseline 75% first-pass, 90% target by final run. Also recommend we include a small synthetic dataset for the first perf run to avoid PHI exposure.

Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@healthgrid.com>
To: Diego Fernández <diego@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Evaluation Playbook & Success Roadmap for HealthGrid POC

Thanks all — appreciate the fast turnaround and clear owners. Confirmed for the 02/25 10:30 AM PT kickoff (calendar invite received). A couple of follow-ups before the call: 

1) We'll bring Antonio (infra) and Laura Chen (security) — Laura wants to review the SOC2 + architecture doc; Evelyn, can you share those ahead of the call?
2) For the perf run, could you provision a temporary Grafana view or read-only dashboard with baseline metrics so our infra folks can see current latency profiles? That will help us validate the baseline numbers during the call.
3) Matt will own the prompt tagging and will share the first batch by 03/01.

On the attachments and links: I can access the Drive folder and HubSpot deal link you shared. Looking forward to the kickoff and the first perf pass.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Senior Product Manager | HealthGrid Inc.
elena@healthgrid.com | +1 (617) 555-0199
